axilwr2wbsp.summary: AXI-Lite write-to-Wishbone bridge that pairs AW and W beats (with skid holding registers), issues WB write strobes, and tracks requests via first/mid/last FIFO pointers to return in-order B responses with error propagation.

blocks.name: AXI write intake
blocks.description: AW/W handshakes with holding registers pairing address and data

anchors.name: i_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write-address valid captured into r_addr or forwarded

anchors.name: o_axi_awready
anchors.why: AW ready dropped on WB stall, error, FIFO full or missing write data

anchors.name: i_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI write-data valid captured into r_data or forwarded

anchors.name: o_axi_wready
anchors.why: W ready dropped on WB stall, error, FIFO full or missing address

anchors.name: i_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: AXI write address, word bits sent to WB address

anchors.name: i_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data forwarded or held for WB

anchors.name: r_awvalid
anchors.why: Held-address valid when AW arrived before it could be issued

anchors.name: r_addr
anchors.why: Holds AW address until paired write is issued

anchors.name: r_wvalid
anchors.why: Held-data valid when W arrived before it could be issued

anchors.name: r_data
anchors.why: Holds W data until paired write is issued

anchors.name: pending_axi_write
anchors.why: Both address and data available for a write

blocks.name: WB master issue
blocks.description: Issues WB write strobes and tracks outstanding acks

anchors.name: axi_write_accepted
anchors.why: Fires when AW+W pair available, FIFO not full, WB not stalled; launches WB strobe

anchors.name: o_wb_stb
anchors.why: WB write strobe set on accepted AXI write, cleared when not stalled

anchors.name: o_wb_cyc
anchors.why: WB cycle active while strobe or acks pending

anchors.name: o_wb_addr
anchors.why: WB word address from r_addr or direct AXI awaddr

anchors.name: o_wb_data
anchors.why: WB write data from r_data or direct AXI wdata

anchors.name: o_wb_sel
anchors.why: WB byte selects from r_sel or AXI wstrb

anchors.name: i_wb_ack
anchors.why: WB acknowledge advancing r_mid and raising bvalid

anchors.name: i_wb_stall
anchors.why: WB stall holding strobe/payload and dropping AXI readies

anchors.name: i_wb_err
anchors.why: WB error input setting err_state and err_loc

anchors.name: wb_outstanding
anchors.why: Counts WB requests awaiting ack

anchors.name: wb_pending
anchors.why: WB acks pending flag keeping o_wb_cyc high

blocks.name: Transaction tracking FIFO
blocks.description: First/mid/last pointers tracking issued, acked and responded writes

anchors.name: r_first
anchors.why: Count of issued WB requests (FIFO write pointer)

anchors.name: r_mid
anchors.why: Count of WB acks/errs received (middle pointer)

anchors.name: r_last
anchors.why: Count of B responses returned (FIFO read pointer)

anchors.name: fifo_full
anchors.why: Outstanding-transaction FIFO full; blocks acceptance and AXI readies

anchors.name: fifo_empty
anchors.why: FIFO empty flag (unused, formal only)

blocks.name: Response and error
blocks.description: Generates B responses in order, marking WB-errored transactions

anchors.name: o_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid raised on WB ack/err, held while responses remain

anchors.name: o_axi_bresp
anchors.why: Write response code, SLVERR for the errored transaction location

anchors.name: err_state
anchors.why: Error mode after WB err; kills strobes and drains responses with errors

anchors.name: err_loc
anchors.why: Records r_mid position of failed transaction for bresp

axilrd2wbsp.summary: AXI-Lite read to pipelined Wishbone bridge: issues WB reads per AR request with a shadow skid register, returns acks into a FIFO tracked by first/mid/last pointers, and drains it as AXI R responses with error tracking.

blocks.name: AXI read address front-end
blocks.description: Accepts AR requests with skid shadow register when Wishbone stalls

anchors.name: i_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read-address valid starting a Wishbone read

anchors.name: o_axi_arready
anchors.why: AR ready dropped on stall, FIFO full or error

anchors.name: i_axi_araddr
anchors.why: AXI read address converted to word address for Wishbone

anchors.name: r_stb
anchors.why: Shadow request pending while Wishbone stalls

anchors.name: r_addr
anchors.why: Shadow address held during stall

blocks.name: Wishbone master
blocks.description: Issues pipelined Wishbone reads and counts outstanding acks

anchors.name: o_wb_stb
anchors.why: Wishbone request strobe raised on AR handshake or shadow request

anchors.name: o_wb_cyc
anchors.why: Wishbone cycle held while strobe or pending acks

anchors.name: o_wb_addr
anchors.why: Wishbone word address from AXI address or shadow r_addr

anchors.name: i_wb_stall
anchors.why: Wishbone stall holding strobe and arming shadow request

anchors.name: i_wb_ack
anchors.why: Wishbone ack writing returned data into FIFO

anchors.name: i_wb_err
anchors.why: Wishbone bus error aborting cycle and entering error state

anchors.name: wb_outstanding
anchors.why: Count of outstanding Wishbone requests awaiting ack

anchors.name: wb_pending
anchors.why: Outstanding-ack flag keeping o_wb_cyc asserted

anchors.name: i_wb_data
anchors.why: Wishbone read data stored into dfifo

anchors.name: dfifo
anchors.why: Read-data FIFO buffering Wishbone results for AXI R channel

anchors.name: r_first
anchors.why: Pointer of accepted AXI requests (FIFO allocation)

anchors.name: r_mid
anchors.why: Write pointer for returned Wishbone data

anchors.name: r_last
anchors.why: Read pointer for AXI responses

anchors.name: fifo_full
anchors.why: FIFO full flag throttling arready

blocks.name: AXI read response and error
blocks.description: Drives R channel and propagates Wishbone errors as AXI responses

anchors.name: o_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid set on WB ack/err, cleared as FIFO drains

anchors.name: i_axi_rready
anchors.why: AXI read data accept advancing FIFO read pointer

anchors.name: o_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Read data from FIFO at r_last

anchors.name: o_axi_rresp
anchors.why: AXI read response, SLVERR/DECERR after Wishbone error

anchors.name: err_state
anchors.why: Error flush mode after WB error; blocks requests and sets error responses

anchors.name: err_loc
anchors.why: FIFO slot where the Wishbone error occurred

wbarbiter.summary: Two-master Wishbone arbiter: a 1-bit owner register (alternating scheme) muxes A or B request signals onto the shared bus and routes ack/stall/err back to the owner.

blocks.name: Arbiter
blocks.description: Alternating grant logic choosing owner from A/B cyc and stb requests.

anchors.name: r_a_owner
anchors.why: Grant bit selecting master A or B; steers all output muxes and return-path gating.

anchors.name: ALT.last_owner
anchors.why: Remembers last bus owner so idle grant alternates between masters.

anchors.name: i_a_cyc
anchors.why: Master A bus request; drives grant decisions and o_cyc.

anchors.name: i_b_cyc
anchors.why: Master B bus request; drives grant decisions and o_cyc.

blocks.name: Request mux
blocks.description: Muxes owning master's cyc/stb/we/adr/dat/sel onto shared bus.

anchors.name: o_cyc
anchors.why: Arbitrated bus-cycle output, copy of owner's cyc line.

anchors.name: o_stb
anchors.why: Arbitrated strobe output from owning master.

anchors.name: o_we
anchors.why: Muxed write-enable command from owning master.

anchors.name: o_adr
anchors.why: Muxed address from owning master to the shared bus.

anchors.name: o_dat
anchors.why: Muxed write data from owning master to shared bus.

anchors.name: o_sel
anchors.why: Muxed byte-select lanes from owning master.

blocks.name: Response router
blocks.description: Routes ack/stall/err from slave back to the owning master only.

anchors.name: i_ack
anchors.why: Slave acknowledge routed back only to the owning master.

anchors.name: i_stall
anchors.why: Slave stall forwarded to owner; non-owner always stalled.

anchors.name: o_a_ack
anchors.why: Acknowledge to master A, gated by ownership.

anchors.name: o_b_ack
anchors.why: Acknowledge to master B, gated by ownership.

anchors.name: o_a_stall
anchors.why: Stall to master A; forced high when A lacks the bus.

anchors.name: o_b_stall
anchors.why: Stall to master B; forced high when B lacks the bus.

axlite2wbsp.summary: AXI-Lite to pipelined Wishbone bridge: separate write and read bridge instances each master a Wishbone port, merged onto one bus by a two-master Wishbone arbiter.

blocks.name: AXI write bridge
blocks.description: Write decoder converting AW/W beats to WB writes and B responses.

anchors.name: i_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write address valid into the write bridge.

anchors.name: i_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: AXI write address forwarded to write bridge.

anchors.name: i_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI write data valid into write bridge.

anchors.name: i_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data passed to write bridge for WB writes.

anchors.name: o_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid from write bridge.

anchors.name: w_wb_cyc
anchors.why: Write bridge WB cycle request into arbiter channel B.

anchors.name: w_wb_addr
anchors.why: Write bridge WB address into arbiter.

anchors.name: w_wb_data
anchors.why: Write bridge WB write data into arbiter.

anchors.name: w_wb_ack
anchors.why: Arbiter-routed ack back to write bridge.

blocks.name: AXI read bridge
blocks.description: Read decoder converting AR requests to WB reads and R responses.

anchors.name: i_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read address valid into the read bridge.

anchors.name: i_axi_araddr
anchors.why: AXI read address forwarded to read bridge.

anchors.name: o_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid from read bridge.

anchors.name: o_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI read data returned by read bridge from WB.

anchors.name: r_wb_cyc
anchors.why: Read bridge WB cycle request into arbiter channel A.

anchors.name: r_wb_addr
anchors.why: Read bridge WB address into arbiter.

anchors.name: r_wb_ack
anchors.why: Arbiter-routed ack back to read bridge.

blocks.name: Wishbone arbiter
blocks.description: Two-master arbiter muxing read and write bridges onto shared WB bus.

anchors.name: o_wb_cyc
anchors.why: Shared Wishbone cycle from arbiter output.

anchors.name: o_wb_stb
anchors.why: Shared Wishbone strobe from arbiter output.

anchors.name: o_wb_addr
anchors.why: Arbitrated Wishbone address from read or write side.

anchors.name: o_wb_data
anchors.why: Arbitrated Wishbone write data.

anchors.name: i_wb_ack
anchors.why: Wishbone ack routed by arbiter to owning bridge.

anchors.name: i_wb_data
anchors.why: Wishbone read data fed directly to read bridge.

anchors.name: i_wb_stall
anchors.why: Wishbone stall routed back through arbiter.

ungrouped_anchors.name: o_reset
ungrouped_anchors.why: Active-high reset output derived from AXI reset.
